stop.label: Stop
stop.meaning: Come to a complete stop before the stop line. Proceed only when the way is clear.
stop.purpose: Controls right of way at an intersection and helps prevent conflicting traffic movements.
stop.action: Stop fully, check all directions, give way to pedestrians, and continue only when it is safe.

no entry.label: No Entry
no entry.meaning: Vehicles are not allowed to enter the road or lane from this direction.
no entry.purpose: Prevents vehicles from entering a road or lane against its permitted direction of travel.
no entry.action: Do not enter. Find a permitted route and follow any diversion signs.

speed limit 50.label: Speed Limit · 50
speed limit 50.meaning: The maximum permitted speed on this stretch is 50 km/h.
speed limit 50.purpose: Sets a maximum speed to regulate traffic and reduce risk on this stretch of road.
speed limit 50.action: Keep your speed at or below the posted limit and reduce it further for road, weather, and traffic conditions.

speed limit 50 km h.label: Speed Limit · 50
speed limit 50 km h.meaning: The maximum permitted speed on this stretch is 50 km/h.
speed limit 50 km h.purpose: Sets a maximum speed to regulate traffic and reduce risk on this stretch of road.
speed limit 50 km h.action: Keep your speed at or below the posted limit and reduce it further for road, weather, and traffic conditions.

school ahead.label: School Ahead
school ahead.meaning: A school or school crossing is ahead, where children may cross the road.
school ahead.purpose: Warns drivers about children and school-related activity ahead.
school ahead.action: Slow down, watch both sides of the road, and be ready to stop for children.

pedestrian crossing.label: Pedestrian Crossing
pedestrian crossing.meaning: A marked crossing for people walking is ahead.
pedestrian crossing.purpose: Alerts drivers to a designated place where pedestrians may cross.
pedestrian crossing.action: Slow down and give pedestrians space to cross safely.

no parking.label: No Parking
no parking.meaning: Parking is prohibited in the area covered by this sign.
no parking.purpose: Keeps the signed area clear of parked vehicles.
no parking.action: Keep the area clear and look for a designated parking space.

give way.label: Give Way
give way.meaning: You must yield to traffic on the road you are approaching.
give way.purpose: Assigns priority to traffic on the road being approached.
give way.action: Slow down, check for traffic and pedestrians, and wait until there is a safe gap.

no u turn.label: No U-turn
no u turn.meaning: Making a U-turn is prohibited at this point.
no u turn.purpose: Prevents U-turn movements at a location where they are prohibited.
no u turn.action: Continue ahead and turn around only where signs and road markings allow it.
